scope: harbor-first; reusable across lands and routes
alignment: all visible text, location glyph and difficulty glyph centered; Persian RTL

identity.locationId: place identity; e.g. port; independent from route difficulty
identity.difficultyId: semantic tier; independent from place and list order
identity.artAssetId: replaceable illustration; does not identify progress
identity.frameThemeId: shared frame settings; does not own card content

locationBadge.reuse: same location badge for fishing and pirate routes

proposalLimits: not connected to the runtime renderer

interaction.confirmationFrequency: owner requires confirmation also for core selection; replay/session frequency still undecided
interaction.coreConfirmationCopyStatus: proposed mockup wording; owner requires core confirmation/actions

geometry.peerCards: equal outer width and height within each responsive layout; includes future monster card
geometry.mobile: portrait vertical equal cards with scrolling when needed
geometry.largeText: shared adaptive height or responsive reflow; no essential clipping or font shrinking
geometry.orientation: landscape not required for route selection
geometry.rearCardAppearance: only title strip visible; true near-background grayscale; readable neutral text and clickable/focusable input; never imply lock

environmentFrame.selection: replaceable location-specific theme; separate from semantic difficulty palette and shared card geometry
environmentFrame.harbor: restrained rope wraps and wooden edges
environmentFrame.carpentry: wood joinery/grain and workshop motifs; art direction still pending
environmentFrame.density: retain a few meaningful environmental details; avoid both generic bare frames and ornamental overload
environmentFrame.surface: matte/moderate chroma; selected action more visually prominent than decorative frame

paletteHierarchy.background: plain quiet neutral; no sky/clouds/wood competing with art
paletteHierarchy.rearCards: true grayscale, slightly raised above background; readable neutral text; no tier-color tint
paletteHierarchy.activeCard: one owned tier family across scene/frame/details; quiet gray/ivory neutrals allowed
paletteHierarchy.crossFamilyAccents: do not introduce red/orange/gold into green fishing frame, wood chips, net or rope
paletteHierarchy.contextualRope: muted matte gray; limited density; no golden highlights
paletteHierarchy.foregroundScene: fishing remains sunlit green/teal; pirate copper-orange; sea dragon crimson/burgundy
paletteHierarchy.check: review whole card, not only frame; recheck after every art edit
